archetypes.name: dyn-oos-audit
archetypes.rationale: Verify zero-drop pre-vote OOS audits clear stale parent copies without changing ballot behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pre-vote OOS audit copy path in python/review_pipeline.py. Check that zero-drop rounds still write and copy an empty public audit when a session env path is present. Confirm missing session env paths still no-op, and that failures remain fail-closed through PreVoteGateError. Inspect the regression test for realistic coverage of stale parent audit cleanup and unchanged ballot content. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
